violation_type.title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector- Director or Designee Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §744.3757(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector- Director or Designee Check All Detectors Monthly
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation does not have a working carbon monoxide detector.     Note: The Program Director replaced the batteries and tested the carbon monoxide detector. It now works properly.

finding_variants.text: The operation does not have a working carbon monoxide detector.     Note: The Program Director replaced the batteries and tested the carbon monoxide detector. It now works properly.
The carbon monoxide detection system was not tested in the month of February 2025.   This was corrected at inspection when the director conducted the inspection.
At the time of inspection, there was no documentation that the carbon monoxide detector has  been tested since December 2022.
The operation does not have documented monthly fire inspections.
Carbon Monoxide Detectors have not been tested monthly. The director tested the Carbon monoxided dectors at the time of inspection.
